python3 - <<'PY'
# Rural Electrification Administration Treasury Holdings (millions of dollars)
# From Table FD-10, fiscal years 1961-1970
rea_values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

n = len(rea_values)
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Values: {rea_values}")

mean_val = sum(rea_values) / n
print(f"Mean = {mean_val}")

# Theil index: T = (1/n) * sum((x_i / mean) * log(x_i / mean))
import math
theil_sum = sum((x / mean_val) * math.log(x / mean_val) for x in rea_values)
theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"Theil index = {theil_index}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths = {round(theil_index, 3)}")
PY

import math

# REA Treasury Holdings values for fiscal years 1961-1970 (millions of dollars)
# Using fiscal year data from Table FD-10
rea_fy = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]
years = list(range(1961, 1971))

print("Fiscal Year Data (Table FD-10):")
for y, v in zip(years, rea_fy):
    print(f"  FY {y}: {v}")

mean_fy = sum(rea_fy) / len(rea_fy)
print(f"\nMean = {mean_fy}")

# Theil index: T = (1/n) * sum((x_i / mean) * log(x_i / mean))
theil_sum = sum((x / mean_fy) * math.log(x / mean_fy) for x in rea_fy)
theil_index = theil_sum / len(rea_fy)

print(f"\nTheil index (FY 1961-1970) = {theil_index}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths = {round(theil_index, 3)}")
PY

import math

# REA Treasury Holdings values for fiscal years 1961-1970 (millions of dollars)

theil_index = theil_sum / n
print(f"\nTheil sum = {theil_sum:.10f}")
print(f"Theil index = {theil_index:.15f}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths = {round(theil_index, 3)}")
